code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low O₂ saturation and pO₂), with mild leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and relative basophilia. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits. Findings suggest severe respiratory compromise with possible bone marrow suppression or infection; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
